name: use-megamind
description: A React hook for managing asynchronous function calls with ease, including loading state management, error handling, and customizable options for delayed or repeated calls.

scripts.setup: echo "📦 Installing dependencies..." && yarn install && cd examples/server && yarn install && cd ../react-app && yarn install && echo "✅ Setup complete!"
scripts.examples: kill-port 15001 15002; concurrently --kill-others --prefix "[{name}]" --names "SERVER,CLIENT" --prefix-colors "yellow,cyan" "cd examples/server && yarn start" "cd examples/react-app && yarn start"
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist && rm -rf examples/server/node_modules && rm -rf examples/react-app/node_modules && rm -rf node_modules
